paragraphs: Chattermill’s mission to turn every customer interaction into actionable insight mirrors my recent work on NLP pipelines that surface hidden sentiment from unstructured text.
I built NLP and agentic RAG workflows using Hugging Face Transformers, Ollama, LangChain and LangGraph, enabling rapid retrieval‑augmented generation for complex queries.
I developed an XGBoost churn classifier in R with tidymodels, applying a two‑stage Bayesian hyperparameter search, SMOTE within the recipe and MCC evaluation to maximise predictive accuracy.
